items.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra - What We’re Working On
items.contents:
Over the weekend, we released Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra. The launch went well, and we’re glad to see so many Exiles joining us for the newest expansion.

During the launch, we hotfixed a few urgent issues and addressed several more in a patch. You can check out the patch notes [url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-forum/patch-notes]here[/url].

While we’re still monitoring feedback, we’d like to outline some of the things we’re currently working on and are planning to release as individual hotfixes as soon as they are ready:

[list]
[*] Looking into particular Thread mods and Fate empowerments that are individually too dangerous and out of line, with changes already on the way for some outliers.
[*] Looking into smoothing out the early experience of Threads and Shaped Regions so they are less spiky and dangerous when first entering maps.
[*] We will be doing a pass on existing Thread mods to generally make ones which add difficulty more worthwhile, either in making that difficulty less punitive or the rewards more enticing, or both.
[*] We will be adjusting the behaviour of Wisps released by Harvest encounters, such that they do not spread to Unique or Rare monsters by default, instead having this be enabled by an Atlas Passive so players can opt into that level of difficulty.
[*] We will adjust Thread expenditure to limit the number that can be spent early on, so that players are less likely to attempt extremely high thread counts very early, which will be too challenging to accomplish at that point. This way, higher Thread count content will naturally be introduced to players as they get powerful enough to handle it.
[*] Additionally, we will be doing a pass on baseline Thread stats, to lower the amount of toughness they add at lower Thread counts.
[*] We are aware of a bug where the thread count sent on your map device is sometimes being lost between instance changes. For now, if you place your threads in your map device inventory, this shouldn't happen. We're looking into a more comprehensive fix.
[/list]

There are also quite a few issues on our radar, such as the Delve map not showing paths or the size of icons on the Fates, which will be addressed soon.

We'll continue monitoring your feedback and releasing hotfixes for bugs and crashes as soon as possible. Thank you for your reports and patience!

items.title: Path of Exile 1: Covens of Umbra Twitch Drops
items.contents:
To celebrate the launch of Path of Exile 1: Covens of Umbra, we’ll be running a week of Twitch Drops starting from November 13th 11:00AM PST!

[h3]Umbral Tentacle Slam Rare Finisher Effect[/h3]

[b]Start Time:[/b] November 13th 11:00AM PST 
[b]End Time: [/b]November 22nd 11:00AM PST 

For watching any creator in the Path of Exile category for 3 hours you’ll receive the Umbral Tentacle Slam Rare Finisher Effect.

[h3]Support a Streamer[/h3]
To show our gratitude to our amazing community of creators, we’ll also be offering the Umbral Portal Effect for purchasing or gifting 2 Twitch Subscriptions of any tier during the twitch drop promotion.

To participate:
[list]
[*] Log in to your Twitch account.
[*] Visit any Twitch channel in Path of Exile 1 category.
[*] While the channel is live streaming Path of Exile 1, purchase a cumulative of two subscriptions of any tier to earn the Umbral Portal Effect. (Prime Subs are excluded).
[/list]

[b]How do I link my Path of Exile account with Twitch?[/b]
Visit your [url=https://www.pathofexile.com/my-account/connections]Twitch Settings[/url] page while logged in. If your account isn't connected, click the "Connect" button for Twitch under "Other Connections". Please also make sure that the sub-account you’re linking with Twitch is the one that you want to receive the Drops on. Complete the process on Twitch and you will be redirected back to your Twitch Settings page. If your account is already connected, this page should say "Your Path of Exile account is currently linked to your Twitch account."

[b]How do I redeem my rewards?[/b]
After you've accumulated enough watch time to earn your Drops, you must redeem them from your [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory]Twitch Inventory[/url] before the promotional period ends.

The Umbral Portal Effect for Twitch Subscriptions must also be claimed from the Twitch Inventory.

[b]How do I enable Twitch Drops on my channel?[/b]
If you’re planning to stream Path of Exile 1 at launch and want to enable Twitch Drops for your viewers, you can do it via your Twitch Creator Dashboard [url=https://dashboard.twitch.tv/drops]here[/url].

[b]How do I purchase or gift a subscription on Twitch?[/b]
Log into Twitch, using either a PC or mobile device. Purchases may be made on either a PC or mobile device. Detailed information on purchasing subscriptions can be found [url=https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/how-to-subscribe?language=en_US]here[/url], and information on purchasing gift subscriptions can be found [url=https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/gift-subscriptions?language=en_US]here[/url].

[b]Which Twitch subscriptions are eligible for the Support a Streamer promo?[/b]
[list]
[*] New monthly subs (any tier)
[*] Multi-month subs (3-month, 6-month)
[*] Gift subs (any tier for any number of months)
[/list]
[b]Are Twitch Drops rewards and the Umbral Portal Effect exclusive?[/b]
The cosmetics that are part of this campaign will not be exclusive to Twitch Drops and will eventually be sold in our Microtransactions Store.

[b]Will these cosmetics work in Path of Exile 2?[/b]
Yes, all cosmetics from this promotion will be made available for use in Path of Exile 2 in the future.

items.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra is Now Available!
items.contents:
Disrupt dark magicks and put an end to the powerful witchcraft of the Coven Queen in Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra.

Our November expansion introduces a new challenge league, a set of fundamental changes to the endgame alongside improvements to existing endgame systems, new unique items, and more!

[previewyoutube=XaySR0RjRPA;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5193306/841ab58d1a52e037755808297b409ad34c49592a.png[/img]
[h3]Decide Your Fate[/h3]
Encounter wicked covenites performing gruesome rites to summon their Queen, seeking to plunge the world into unending darkness.

Upon defeating them, you will get to select a Fate for the boss of the area you're in. Each Fate has a handful of effects, increasing both the rewards and difficulty of the encounter.

[h3]Empower Your Flesh[/h3]
The twisted witchcraft of the Coven allows you to put the remains of your fallen enemies to use by placing them on your own Wickerman. Obtain Viscera from a defeated boss empowered by Fates to claim a scrap of their power for your own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5193306/4841c03e3b6b9986b5cb9e2624ea57187600b2dc.jpg[/img]
[h3]The Grim Fates[/h3]
The influence of the Coven Queen can reach even the deepest memories of the Atlas. Grim Fates allow you to empower the most difficult bosses within the Atlas in pursuit of the greatest of trophies: Pinnacle Boss Viscera.

Perhaps... you'll even be able to hold back the Queen herself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5193306/3fd11a4f0be27842229426048acca6f7a80a27e6.png[/img]
[h3]Introducing Threads of Creation[/h3]
Scarabs are being removed and replaced by a new system, Threads of Creation.

Set directly in the Map device, Threads apply a chosen league mechanic to the area, while scaling the rarity and difficulty of monsters. For each thread spent, you'll increase the chances of random powerful effects augmenting that league mechanic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5193306/d7352ea1ad196821cc0f0f31ecb70192485eaf61.jpg[/img]

[h3]Atlas Tree Overhaul[/h3]
The Atlas passive tree has been completely refreshed, with a new layout, and dozens of entirely new wheels, stats, and effects - many of which were previously on Scarabs that you can now guarantee.

[h3]Improvements to Existing Leagues[/h3]
In Covens of Umbra, almost every endgame league mechanic has been augmented, modified, or revamped in some way:
[list]
[*] Mirages have returned, with a chance to spawn randomly in Maps - or as a rollable Map modifier along with other mechanics like Mirrors of Delirium or the Viridian Wildwood.
[*] Slaying Beyond Bosses no longer stops monster Beyond portals from spawning. Sometimes when you defeat a Beyond boss, they'll open a portal to their realm. 
[*] The Sacred Grove no longer appears in Maps, instead being replaced with tangled roots. You can even use currency on them to add modifiers.
[*] Gwennen now offers an entirely new service, but her gambling days are far from over. She just gambles on your items now!
[*] Atziri has moved into the Temple of Atzoatl, kicking out the Vaal Omnitect, and she has made several adjustments. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5193306/965793509f3b4c7e7ecb3b717ff7b039470eb3ec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5193306/6f0f9aac617d8c2d6cc7d5e3b8cf3f20865dd2fd.png[/img]
[h3]Massive Loot Rework[/h3]
In this expansion, we’re making fundamental changes to how loot drops in Path of Exile, unlike anything we’ve done before.

And of course, as with any of our releases, new Unique items have made their way to Wraeclast with this expansion.

[h3]Play Path of Exile: Covens on Umbra for free on November 13 (PST) across all available platforms.[/h3]

items.title: Two Weeks Until ExileCon 2026!
items.contents:
ExileCon 2026 is happening in just two weeks! If you’ll be watching the convention online, here’s some information you may find useful.

[b]Livestream time[/b]
The keynote officially starts at 1:00 PM on November 6th PST. We’ll go live at 12:30 PM with a pre-show discussion featuring community streamers ZiggyD, Mathil, RaizQT and DarthMicrotransaction.

[b]Where to watch?[/b]
We’ll be streaming on our official Twitch channel www.twitch.tv/pathofexile and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@playpathofexile]YouTube[/url].

[b]How long is the keynote?[/b]
The main presentation showcasing the latest Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2 developments is around 2 hours long, and will be followed by other content throughout the two days.

[b]What else is being streamed from ExileCon?[/b]
Various talks from our developers, live gameplay showcases, interviews, and, of course, race finales for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2! We’ll post the full schedule later this week.

[b]What if I can't watch the livestream as it happens? Will a video of it be posted afterwards?[/b]
Yes. The keynote will be available to watch on our Twitch and YouTube channels shortly after it airs live. The developers’ talks and panels will be posted sometime after ExileCon. We will eventually publish all of them so you can rewatch them at any time.

[b]Will you be running Twitch Drops during the livestream?[/b]
Yes! We’ll announce the rewards next week (they are very cool).

[b]Will announcement pages for the new expansions be released as usual?[/b]
Yes. We treat ExileCon as our regular livestream, so all relevant trailers and announcement pages will be available as soon as the content is announced during the keynote.

We can’t wait to show you what we’ve been working on. See you all very soon!

items.title: Path of Exile 1 3.30 Expansion Timeline
items.contents:
With the Curse of the Allflame approaching its third month since launch, it’s time to talk about the timeline for the next Path of Exile 1 content expansion.

During the Q&A following the 3.29 livestream, we announced that 3.30 would launch this year. Our next expansion for Path of Exile 1 will be released on November 13 (PST), with full details to be revealed at ExileCon 2026 this November. You can watch the event here.

The Curse of the Allflame Challenge League will end at 1PM November 9th (PST), so there are still several weeks left to complete any remaining challenges if you haven't finished them yet.

We are truly excited to reveal our latest developments and can’t wait for ExileCon. See you soon!

items.title: The Last of the Druids Sale - Get One Free Mystery Box When You Spend Points
items.contents:
This weekend, we’re running a sale on microtransactions from past Mystery Boxes, including the Last of the Druids cosmetic effects. In addition, we’re offering one free Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box when you spend points in the store.

[h3]Weekend Sale[/h3]
From the time of this news post until Sep 28, 2026 4:00 PM PST, all cosmetic effects from the Sentinel, Kalandra, Sanctum, Crucible, Ancestor, Affliction, Necropolis, Settlers, Dawn of the Hunt, Third Edict and Last of the Druids Mystery Boxes, as well as their variations, are going on sale, so you can grab them at a discounted price!

Check out the contents of the Last of the Druids Mystery Box below.

[previewyoutube=EM5FqUDBHjo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Get a free Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box When You Spend Points[/h3]
For the duration of the weekend sale, we’re offering one free Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box when you spend any amount of points in the store. This means you can purchase anything discounted in the sale or any other microtransaction from the store and receive one Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box as a gift from us. 

[b]Please note:[/b] It’s only possible to get one free Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box from this promotion. Making additional microtransaction purchases will not grant additional Mystery Boxes. Purchasing a supporter pack will not grant a free Mystery Box but spending points from a supporter pack can grant a free Mystery Box.

Players who have unlocked all microtransactions from the Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box will receive two Warlord Mystery Boxes instead.

Thank you for your support!

items.title: Path of Exile 1 ExileCon Qualifiers Begin Next Week
items.contents:
It’s finally happening! The ExileCon Path of Exile 1 Qualifiers kick off next week, with the top racers from all four qualifier events earning the chance to compete in the live final at ExileCon in New Zealand.

The competition will take place on the following dates, with ZiggyD and Raiz once again serving as your hosts throughout the event:

[b]Path of Exile 1 Qualifier Event Times and Dates[/b]
[list]
[*] Qualifier One - September 4 2PM PDT
[*] Qualifier Two - September 11 2PM PDT
[*] Qualifier Three - September 18 2PM PDT
[*] Qualifier Four - September 25 2PM PDT[/list]
If you're participating in the event, please make sure that your Path of Exile account is linked to your Twitch account. You can do this by logging into your account on the website, then clicking here.

To join a qualifier event, click the "Join" button for the race on the Character Select screen. You'll then be prompted to create a character. Once you've entered the game, your character will remain stationary until the race officially begins.

Players will compete to be the first to kill Kitava in Act 5 in a Standard Solo Self-Found fixed-seed environment. While this is not a Hardcore event, players will incur a penalty upon death and will be unable to move until one minute has elapsed.

The qualifier events are PC only.

You can find the full ruleset [url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3985393]here[/url].

Be sure to join us at [url=twitch.tv/pathofexile]twitch.tv/pathofexile[/url] to check out all the action! New Twitch Drops will be available for viewers, and we’ll announce them next week.

Good luck, Exiles!
